name: @audit-core/mcp-server

tools.name: auditcore_start_scan
tools.description: Start a new security scan on a URL. Returns a scan_id you can poll with auditcore_scan_status. Free tier runs a 1-page audit (SEO + AI-readiness + security headers) without authentication. Use this when the user mentions 'scan', 'audit', 'check security', 'test for vulnerabilities', or pastes a URL with such intent.

target.description: URL of the web application to scan (e.g. https://example.com). For mobile app scans (APK/IPA) use the AuditCore web upload at /scan — MCP does not accept binary uploads.

tier.description: Scan plan. 'free' = 1 page SEO + security headers + AI-readiness, no card. 'basic' ($99) = SSL/TLS, CORS, nmap, 25 pages. 'pro' ($299) = ZAP + Nuclei + JWT, 100 pages. 'enterprise' ($499) = BOLA/BFLA, sqlmap, SSRF, mobile binary, AI prompt-injection, 500 pages. Paid tiers require API key authentication and existing license.

email.description: Email for scan result notifications. Required for anonymous (free-tier) scans if no API key is set. Optional for authenticated calls — uses your account email by default.

tools.name: auditcore_scan_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a running scan. Returns progress %, current phase, current tool, and partial findings summary. Free-tier scans complete in 1-3 minutes; paid scans take 10-30 minutes.

scan_id.description: UUID of the scan returned by auditcore_start_scan

tools.name: auditcore_scan_results
tools.description: Fetch vulnerability findings from a completed scan. Each finding includes severity, CVSS, CWE, affected URL, description, and a fix hint. Use this after auditcore_scan_status shows status='completed'.

severity.description: Filter to a single severity. Omit to see all findings.

tools.name: auditcore_generate_fix
tools.description: Generate AI-powered fix code for a specific vulnerability. Returns language-aware code (auto-detects tech stack from the scan target), explanation, edge cases, and a verification snippet. Requires AUDITCORE_API_KEY. Daily quota: Basic 10/day, Pro 50/day, Enterprise 200/day.

scan_id.description: UUID of the scan containing the vulnerability

vuln_id.description: UUID of a specific finding (from auditcore_scan_results)

tools.name: auditcore_list_my_scans
tools.description: List the caller's own scans (most recent first). Use when the user asks 'what have I scanned', 'show my audits', or wants to continue work on an earlier scan. Requires AUDITCORE_API_KEY.
